product_name_specific: Speed Triple 1200 RR, Speed Triple 1200 RS
risk_description: Improper thread shape on the rear axle may result in inactivation of the mating bolt thread lock compound. Consequently the brake disc mounting screws may loosen and come into contact with other components of the vehicle,  causing the rider to fall.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
